record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: For an arithmetic manifold with joint eigenfunctions of invariant differential operators and Hecke operators, is Riemannian volume the only arithmetic quantum limit?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 50 (Arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity). The Riemannian vol-ume is the only arithmetic quantum limit.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M = \Gamma\backslash G/K$ be an arithmetic locally symmetric space, where $G$ is a connected semisimple Lie group, $K\subset G$ a maximal compact subgroup, and $\Gamma\subset G$ a congruence arithmetic lattice. Let $\mathbb{D}(G/K)$ denote the algebra of $G$-invariant differential operators on $G/K$, and let $\mathcal{H}$ denote the corresponding Hecke algebra acting on $L^2(M)$. Consider a sequence $\{\phi_n\}$ of $L^2$-normalized joint eigenfunctions of $\mathbb{D}(G/K)$ and $\mathcal{H}$ such that the eigenvalues of (some/all of) the differential operators tend to infinity. Form the probability measures $\mu_n$ on $M$ with density $|\phi_n|^2$ with respect to the Riemannian volume, and let $\mu$ be any weak-$*$ limit of $\{\mu_n\}$ (an "arithmetic quantum limit"). Prove or disprove: the only arithmetic quantum limit $\mu$ is the normalized Riemannian volume measure on $M$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is established in several settings: Lindenstrauss proved it for congruence quotients of the hyperbolic plane (with Soundararajan ruling out escape of mass in the non-compact case), Holowinsky–Soundararajan handled the holomorphic case, and Shem-Tov–Silberman (2022/2025) proved it for products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces. In the general higher-rank arithmetic setting the conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: Invariant measures and arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity (Lindenstrauss)
status_evidence.snippet: Lindenstrauss establishes AQUE for congruence hyperbolic surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: AQUE proved on congruence quotients of the hyperbolic plane.

status_evidence.title: Arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity for products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces
status_evidence.snippet: AQUE proved for sequences of Hecke–Maass forms on products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-rank case proved for products of hyperbolic 2- and 3-spaces.

status_evidence.title: Background on the Quantum Unique Ergodicity conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of QUE conjecture and partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: The general arithmetic QUE conjecture remains open in higher rank.
